verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow (headline, copy, CTA, product), but 'WEEKEND ONLY' is jammed against the top-left edge and doesn't line up with the indented headline. The body copy sits right up against '20% off', the product is reduced to a tiny can inside a circle clipped by the top edge, and the legal line is very small. B makes the same mistakes and adds worse ones: the legal text is squeezed into a five-line ragged column at the far right, wrapped one or two words per line, and it overlaps the peach circle. The body copy also wraps awkwardly ('Every mixed / case of Solstice / sparkling') and is crammed against the headline, and the product is a tiny can in the leftover space.
